200.description: Only verified/recognized event accepted. Exact channel ACK/media is unresolved until approved provider integration; no generic JSON ACK is prescribed.

post.x-version-guard: server transaction locks original order/refund; no invented provider expected_version
post.x-idempotency: provider event/fact key; do not require custom Idempotency-Key from provider

requestBody.description: Exact original provider bytes. Signature headers/media/ACK determined by verified channel adapter.

value.description: Decimal serialized as exact string; field binding determines semantic type. No floating JSON monetary value.

RuleNode.description: Restricted AST. Domain compiler checks op-specific operands, type, max depth/nodes. Never eval strings.

typed_value.description: Decimal serialized as exact string; field binding determines semantic type. No floating JSON monetary value.

Counts.description: First three dispositions sum to total; issue_count may overlap and is not a fourth disposition.

user_value.description: Decimal serialized as exact string; field binding determines semantic type. No floating JSON monetary value.

Decision.description: CHOOSE_EVIDENCE requires evidence_id; USER_VALUE requires non-null value validated to binding; KEEP_UNRESOLVED preserves issue.

Amount.description: Original channel unit; no implicit CNY conversion.

provider_checkout_payload.description: Opaque approved adapter payload. Actual SDK fields and signature must be verified; never produced by a model.

Data33.description: Client cannot claim VERIFIED_PLATFORM. This endpoint never directly sets DELIVERED.

Data38.description: Optional P1. No implicit merge or cross-platform paid entitlement transfer.

ConsumerSession.description: Our revocable opaque consumer session, not a platform token.

OperatorSession.description: Internal role-limited session; ordinary consumer token rejected.
